textRuns.value: Sources: ENTSO-E (solar generation), Open-Meteo (solar radiation at each country's cities, day and night average), Eurostat (population). The Netherlands and Ireland report almost no solar to ENTSO-E (rooftop solar is missing), so their values are too low. Output per person stands in for installed capacity, so "room to grow" is a pointer, not a verdict. Only country-years with at least 95 % of days covered count (Cyprus: none). Bulgaria and Malta are excluded.
